sections.content:
非常宏經的一門課。期中之前就重點講Simple Solow Model，期中之後覆蓋教育、Credit等內容。個人非常喜歡這麼課的原因在於教授在講清楚理論之後都會用幾篇其實是Graduate School才會讀的論文輔佐理解。提到的論文如果去細細閱讀體會，越發喜歡政經之餘，還能學到非常多新奇的觀點和實踐。
總之，這是一門有ambition的課。發展經濟學是關注人類福祉的學科，對於這樣的學問有熱忱的同學不要錯過。
sections.teaching: 教授英文不是特別好，但是足夠理解。唯一的缺點在於有時候講的太慢，導致學期結束還有很多內容沒有講完。
sections.workload:
在3開頭的課中並不算多。只有兩次Assignment，以及Midterm和Final。這學期的Midterm和final還是non-cumulative。
因為有很多的論文可以讀，所以是一門你想努力workload就能很大，但是混一混也能過去的課。

sections.content: Overall, it was an average course. Very macroecononomics concentrated.  The assignments were very much similar to the examples provided on the textbook.
sections.teaching: She was a detailed teacher. Prompt to answer questions via email. The test material was more from the ppt slides, then from the textbook.
sections.grading: Overall the grading was fair. The assignments were not too hard. And the TA was willing to help.
sections.workload: There were two assignments, midterm, and final. The exam questions were similar to the assignments. the final exam was cumulative, and it was still hard for me even after I devoted some time.
